Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Quinyn Nethor: 39-year-old woman, 168 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: soft rectangular face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: architectural high knot. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; a dense freckle field; one asymmetric ear cuff. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a bone-free wooden comb only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
